method: Independent ASR of delivered MP3s, no authored-text prompt; punctuation/case/apostrophe and 20-to-twenty normalization only. Automated proxy, not human listening acceptance.

lines.speaker: Dispatcher
lines.authoredText: Three workers, two recipients. Different columns. Don't invent a recipient to make the totals agree.
lines.transcription: Three workers, two recipients. Different columns. Don't invent a recipient to make the totals agree.

lines.speaker: Dispatcher
lines.authoredText: Keep the depot return reference. An empty recipient field is not a lost packet.
lines.transcription: Keep the depot return reference. An empty recipient field is not a lost packet.

lines.speaker: Dispatcher
lines.authoredText: Tell me what you want signed. A filing procedure and the truth of a source are different requests.
lines.transcription: Tell me what you want signed. A filing procedure and the truth of a source are different requests.

lines.speaker: Dispatcher
lines.authoredText: I can sign for the filing process. You give up the paid sorting shift; I don't sign for the source.
lines.transcription: I can sign for the filing process. You give up the paid sorting shift. I don't sign for the source.

lines.speaker: Dispatcher
lines.authoredText: A guide explains the form. It doesn't give you my agreement. Use your own signature, or leave the filing open.
lines.transcription: A guide explains the form. It doesn't give you my agreement. Use your own signature or leave the filing open.

lines.speaker: Dispatcher
lines.authoredText: Procedure, not the truth of a source. Keep that limit on the copy.
lines.transcription: Procedure not the truth of a source. Keep that limit on the copy.

lines.speaker: Dispatcher
lines.authoredText: Received for review. That's what the reference says. The correction still needs an answer.

lines.authoredText: I agreed to the procedure. I didn't agree to certify a source I haven't checked.
